text_block_list.text:
Hmph. My results were sufficient.
However...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's next for the interview?
Where's the
schedule?
text_block_list.name: Busy Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the runner
expected to
be Umamusume of the year
is at another venue...
text_block_list.name: Busy Assistant

text_block_list.text:
That senior?! Then let's hurry up and get
outta
here! Grab all the equipment,
quick!
text_block_list.name: Busy Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
This was just a junior race. Everyone
considers this
to be an early stage.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What's important is how we act from
here on, and
how we distinguish
ourselves in future races.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We're heading in the right direction,
Trainer. As a
first-rate Umamusume, I
won't stray from the path
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's keep our sights on the Triple
Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Racers only get one chance to
participate in the
Triple Crown tour, a
series comprised of the
Satsuki Sho, the
Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying, but many
Umamusume
dream of achieving victory
there, so the
competition will surely be
fierce.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: If you're prepared, then let's do it.

text_block_list.text:
I've been prepared for it long before I
ever came
to this academy.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And with that, it's decided. Our next
objective
will be the first race of the
Triple Crown tour: the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
